My experience with Pacific Prime Thailand was excellent from start to finish. I worked with Daniel Bogdan and he was great, he answered my many questions and was very accommodating to all my requests. He helped ease my mind and helped me make the right decision. Even when I was indecisive, resulting in us having to start the process all over from the beginning with a new insurance company, he went above and beyond to accommodate me.
I would highly recommend using their services.

If getting the right international health insurance seems daunting, this is the place to go. It is so reassuring not having to deal with the insurers themselves with their aggressive approaches in their sales process.
My consultant Wouter was peaceful and trustworthy, very organized, knowledgeable, not pushy at all and took all the time to explain different options. When at first I was not accepted because of a very recent road accident he immediately came up with very decent temporary solutions which covered me until I was accepted by the Insurer with the policy I had initially chosen.
I always had the feeling I had a guy in my corner. And God knows how rare that is where and when insurance is concerned.
I am looking forward to a long and fruitful relationship with these brokers and I truly, truly can recommend them.
I will not hesitate to get other kinds of insurance through them

I would like to record my appreciation for Pacific Prime. They assisted me in iteratively comparing, applying for, and securing my (worldwide) health insurance. I want to make special mention of Kei, Daniel and Emalyn in the Bangkok Office, who made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

I sent an initial meeting request to the Company over email and Kei responded in a timely manner, asking all the relevant questions to prepare for the scheduled meeting (with her and Daniel). The office itself was an oasis of calm, with everybody working, holding client meetings, and doing post-sales support in quietly and efficiently. I appreciated the work Kei put in for preparing the presentation, which made it easy for me to narrow down the insurance provider I wanted, and pinpoint the plan which suited my needs. Daniel, being more senior, provided several crucial insights which aided me in making my final choice.

Finally, Emalyn did much of the post-application heavy lifting and liaisoning between the chosen provider and me, and handled both my requests for information and the insurer's requests comprehensively and with due speed.

I hope I never need to use my insurance cover, but I take comfort in knowing that Pacific Prime will be around to assist me if there is ever such a situation. If you are serious about your insurance needs, and not simply checking off a list box requirement, I would recommend using the services of an insurance broker, and my vote is with Pacific Prime.

Much thanks again to Kei, Daniel and Emalyn.

I have really appreciated the customer service provided by Peeradon! He has always been very prompt in answering any questions I have about my insurance coverage whether at home or traveling. Additionally, he assisted with getting a response to my questions from a provider when they were not responding to my emails prior to having surgery. He is a fantastic liaison between the insurance company and providers. I also appreciate the follow-up emails after he has given assistance to make sure that everything worked out. In every email he includes a message to "reach out if you need further assistance," and I know he means it! Thanks for everything, Peeradon!

Working with Nuk at Pacific Prime was so helpful. I have tried for over a year to find a way to reduce our medical premiums but keep my husband on his current plan as he no longer qualifies for new plans due to pre existing conditions. She was able to renegotiate my husbands current plan with Cigna while getting me a new plan with a different service provider helping us to reduce our overall insurance premiums which has gone up significantly for us.  Nuk was patient and diligent and helped us with the process when so many others could not. Not an easy task… I highly recommend her and the pacific prime team.

My experience with Pacific Prime was good. Very good. It was nice to have an intermediary from my own country. 🇾🇪Thank you very much Wouter for everything and for the clear explanation at the office in Bangkok and thank you for your endless patience with me. I made the right choice with Pacific Prime Bangkok. I hope I stay healthy and don't need Pacific Prime, but it's good to know that they are always there for me.

I had an excellent experience  with Khun Gale from Pacific Prime. She was extremely patient, professional, and took the time to explain every detail clearly while helping me find the best medical insurance option for my needs. Her knowledge, responsiveness, and dedication to providing the right solution were truly impressive. She went above and beyond throughout the entire process. Highly recommend Khun Gale to anyone looking for expert insurance advice and outstanding service.

Excellent experience working with Wouter and Jim, who are incredibly responsive and helpful. I initially thought securing health insurance in Thailand would be straightforward and something I could do easily on my own. After going through the process, I now realize Wouter's help negotiating with the insurance companies likely saved me hours, if not days of hassle with underwriting. I very highly recommend Pacific Prime to any expats seeking long-term coverage in Thailand.

Pacific Prime were incredibly efficient, responsive and empathetic and made what can be a complex thing of health insurance a smooth and simplified experience. Thanks to Wouter and Klariza who delivered an exceptional level of professional service. I would highly recommend to others.

We had a great experience with Pacific Prime Bangkok, especially thanks to Wouter. I'm strongly advising against relying on this insurance company. Although my coverage with them began about two months ago, I've encountered an unacceptable level of incompetence from certain individuals. I was assured that monthly payments would be deducted on the 5th of each month, but this often doesn't happen. Sometimes, even after more than 20 days, I have no certainty about when or if the payment will actually be deducted. From their end, I receive no communication. It's as if they vanish into thin air. This leaves me very doubtful about their ability to promptly manage medical emergencies. I repeat, it's only been two months since I signed the contract, but if I could go back, I wouldn't do it again and would look for another insurance company in Bangkok, where there are serious and qualified people. I won't mention the contact person in Bangkok with whom I signed the policy out of respect, but honestly, I'm left speechless. I advise you to look elsewhere.
